You can get an AirTag for $24 right now piecemeal, but getting four together as a set is a way to save even more. Why pay $96 for four when you can save $17? It felt like we had to wait longer for the cost to fall this much for first-gen AirTags, so it’s a little surprising to see the newer, better model available for less. Apple AirTag (second-gen) Apple’s latest AirTags features an upgraded ultra-wideband chip for more precise location tracking, a noticeably louder speaker, and an expanded Bluetooth range. Where to Buy: $99 $79 at Amazon (four-pack) The second-generation AirTag looks identical to the first-generation AirTag. All of its upgrades are inside, and primarily include spec improvements to let you more easily find it. It includes boosted speaker volume, longer range, and overall better tracking capabilities. My colleague Victoria Song had a much easier time tracking the latest AirTag on different floors compared to the older model. Read our review . Some other great Verge-approved deals The biggest Stream Deck that Elgato makes is down to its lowest price since Amazon’s Prime Day in late June. Originally $249.99 for the gadget with 32 programmable keys, it’s $50 off at Amazon and Best Buy , totaling $199.99. Each key can be customized within Elgato’s desktop software for Windows or macOS, letting you set not just the command that executes when you press it, but also the imagery that displays on the key. You can assign simple functions to keys, like muting a mic or turning off a webcam. The integrations run deep, though, letting you create multi-button macros that run with a single button press.
